scope_limits: One finite5W setting keyed broker-death case and one receive-only case. Both ARP-owner deaths, combined cleanup failures, API/credential cases and remaining stall rejection/expiry/duty scopes are still unqualified on the full final graph.

Only the pinned pd-iq-source broker was signaled. The native supervisor retired its DSP and setup siblings. Exact-session journal confirms IQ source ended before setup lifetime closure; no arbitrary PID or direct DSP signal was used.

Abnormal source exit retains cleanup_unconfirmed after Stop. External audits verify the scoped resource retirement without relaxing that conservative public result. Each ordinary successor has fresh IQ and successful public Stop; root inventories precede those successor cycles.

Host trigger/receipt and paused-process times include SSH transport and are not calibrated physical RF-stop latency or FPGA-to-process latency. Peak-held LP readings include training; raw IQ scale and ADC headroom remain uncalibrated. The interrupted analyzer result is unusable and is not a new IMD/ACPR measurement.

Temporary lab host-root bootstrap provides only the reviewed instrumentation. Signal senders drop toUID78666/caps0/NNP1 with only stdio and a pinned pidfd before opening the temporary local trigger socket. Helpers, containers, directories and carriers are retired; the existing diagnostic SSH container remains bench equipment. No persistent privilege or shipping arbitrary-signaling endpoint was added.

No automatic RF retry or calibration-source rearm, AetherTX, processing-settings restoration or radio reboot. Historical natural128sample/cold-bypass causes, whole-radio reboot hang, raw/extended speech, integrated final stock comparison, actual6300, final native packages and release gates remain open.
